text_block_list.name: Commentator's Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Gentildonna is in this position.
She seems to be calmly biding her time, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the TV that had been left on,
footage began playing of the race
Gentildonna ran in the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna, who had been lost in thought,
looked up and turned her attention toward the TV.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that race was a real nail-biter, wasn't it?
What did you think? Our guest, Mr.—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: This is a good chance to "check our answers."
This is a good chance to "check our answers."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Public opinion is a vital metric to judge whether Gentildonna has proven her supreme strength to the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without placing too much confidence in her own senses, she calmly took in objective opinions. Impressed by her wisdom, I listened to the commentator's words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “An undeniably strongest Umamusume beyond description.” At the commentator's words, Gentildonna narrowed her eyes with satisfaction.
choice_data_list: Didn't you feel good about that yourself?
Didn't you feel good about that yourself?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Through an ideal run, I was able to demonstrate my "strength."
Both in name and reality, without holding anything back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall take my leave now.
Until later, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna leaves the Trainer's Room.
Glancing at the sofa, I notice her pumps
have been left behind.
choice_data_list: Did you forget something? ...Wait, it's so heavy?!
Did you forget something? ...Wait, it's so heavy?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so heavy that it could barely be lifted with full strength.
It seems she wears shoes fitted with custom ultra-heavy horseshoes on a daily basis.
choice_data_list: Such incredible power, as always...
Such incredible power, as always...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To embody peerless supremacy,
I constantly strive to remain the strongest at all times.
As a matter of course, without arrogance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was amazed by her attitude, but Gentildonna would surely be troubled without her shoes.
Holding them tightly so as not to drop them, I chased after her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘An unstoppable, supreme Umamusume.’
At the commentator's words,
Gentildonna offered a quiet, serene smile."
choice_data_list: Didn't you feel good about that yourself?
Didn't you feel good about that yourself?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. I was able to run in a way that showed my "strength."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, not yet.
Until I prove to the world that I am the strongest, I will not stop.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, add 50kg to the barbell.
You'll arrange that for me, won't you?"
choice_data_list: Even though you just added 50 kg the other day?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Was that so?
Even 100 kg is fine.
Please prepare enough so we do not run short.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Gentildonna
walked out of the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how much more power will she build up?
While feeling a thrill from her bottomless potential,
I proceeded with purchasing the weights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘An Umamusume worthy of leaving her name in history.’
At the commentator's words,
Gentildonna put on a bored expression.
choice_data_list: Did it feel different from what you expected?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You're right. Seems I was a bit careless at the end.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't shake the world to its core.
I can't call myself the strongest like this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna leaves the Trainer's Room.
It seems she's headed for the gym.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: *huff*... *huff*...

text_block_list.name: Working Out Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No way... Isn't that insane? How can she do one-arm handstand push-ups with all those weights on...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna's menacing intensity as she trains with heavy, imposing weights around her waist completely overwhelms the surrounding Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘A legendary Umamusume from whom great feats are expected.’
At the commentator's words,
Gentildonna pressed her lips into a tight, firm line."
choice_data_list: I think the reception is pretty great, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Surprisingly so.
However—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Anything less than a total victory is meaningless.
I will never show you such an embarrassing display again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Gentildonna took out a stack of
research papers from her bag and began to read.
choice_data_list: (These are all the latest research papers on training.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If you wish to read it, please feel free.
choice_data_list: Thanks. I'll borrow it then.
Thanks. I'll borrow it, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated with the recent race results, she apparently gathered academic papers on her own.
There are even some that were just published yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how complex the paper, she deciphers it herself and makes it her own strength.
Feeling Gentildonna's resolve, I also psyched myself up and read the paper.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A powerhouse Umamusume to keep your eyes on moving forward."
Gentildonna stared intently at the commentator who made that remark.
choice_data_list: Am I angry at myself?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Let us increase the training load.
Please prepare yourself as well.
choice_data_list: Wait. There's no point in just increasing the load

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had put her through the most grueling training possible, yet the results didn't follow. That meant the cause lay elsewhere.
I told her we should analyze it calmly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ......Well then, would you care to tell me?
choice_data_list: Thank you. What I saw as the problem was—
Thank you. The issue I noticed was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My discussion with Gentildonna grew so heated
that before we knew it, the sun had completely set.
I sent her back to the dorm before curfew.
choice_data_list: Didn't get to train at all today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, thanks to our discussion, the training direction we
need to take moving forward has become crystal clear.
I psyched myself up to give it our all starting tomorrow.
